title: InspectorConfig
description: project-inspector.config.json — optional config file in your project root.

ignorePathGlobs.description: Glob patterns (forward slashes) relative to project root. Matched files are excluded from trusted findings.

suppressIssueIds.description: Exact Issue.id values to drop from trusted output.

suppressTitleSubstrings.description: Case-insensitive substrings of Issue.title — any matching issue is dropped from trusted output.

excludeLowConfidence.description: When true, findings with confidence='low' are excluded from scoring and decision output.

gates.description: CI / decision gate thresholds (0–100). Scan fails if scores fall below these.

testFileGlobs.description: Extra fast-glob patterns (relative to project root) counted as test files, in addition to built-in defaults.

intentionalPublicRouteGlobs.description: Route path patterns treated as intentionally public for API auth heuristics. Supports * wildcards.

governanceSuppressions.description: Structured suppressions with owner, reason, and expiry (governance-audit trail).

owner.description: Team or person accountable for this suppression (e.g. 'security-team' or 'alice@example.com').

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 instant after which this suppression is automatically ignored.

titleSubstring.description: Case-insensitive substring of Issue.title to suppress.

pathGlob.description: Glob pattern matching Issue.file paths to suppress.

architecturePolicy.description: Import-layer rules — forbid specific import patterns between layers.

fromPathGlob.description: Glob pattern for source files that should not import matching modules.

importGlob.description: Glob pattern for import paths that are forbidden from matching source files.

message.description: Optional custom message shown when the rule is violated.

policyPack.description: Optional policy pack id — loads packs/<id>.json and merges extra suppressions / ignore globs.
